theme.vibe: bright road trip with rolling wheels and friendly machine sounds

pages.text: This is a car. A car has wheels. It carries people on roads.

images.alt: Cars parked along a colorful street with buildings beside the road.

pages.text: Cars help people go places. To the store. To the park. To visit family.

images.alt: A convertible car driving on a highway road.

pages.text: Cars do not all look the same. Some are small. Some are tall. Some have open tops.

images.alt: A brightly painted four-wheel-drive car with many colors.
A tall SUV driving on a dusty road.

pages.text: Round tires touch the road. The wheels roll, roll, roll.
extras: Tires help a car grip the road.

images.alt: Many black car tires stacked and standing at a tire store.

pages.text: A car is a machine. Under the hood, parts work together to help the car move.

images.alt: A mechanic looking under a car hood and repairing the engine.

pages.text: People buckle up before they ride. Click! A seat belt helps keep riders safer.

images.alt: A teddy bear toy buckled into a child car seat.

pages.text: Some cars fill up with fuel. Some cars plug in and use electricity.

images.alt: A close-up of an electric car plugged in to charge.

pages.text: Long ago, cars looked different. This early car had big wheels and an open shape.

images.alt: An early Benz car in a museum with large thin wheels and an open seat.

pages.text: In a factory, many parts become a car. One part. Another part. Wheels. Seats. Then a car!

images.alt: Cars being built on a factory assembly line.

pages.text: Cars need care. People check the parts, wash off dirt, and help the car work well.

images.alt: A car going through a car wash with water spraying around it.

pages.text: Some cars are race cars. They go fast on special tracks with trained drivers and safety rules.

images.alt: A bright race car driving on a track.

pages.text: Cars are useful. People keep learning how to make travel safer, cleaner, and less crowded.

images.alt: A small electric car parked while recharging at a charging station.
